epithet: He has succeeded who purifies it
lede: Eleven oaths in a row — the longest run in the Qurʾan — by the sun, the moon, the day, the night, the sky, the earth and the soul. All of them are sworn to a single sentence about that last one.

names.name: al-Shams
names.note: After the first thing it swears by. The Prophet ﷺ named it by its opening words, Wa-l-shamsi wa-ḍuḥāhā, when he told Muʿādh what to recite (al-Bukhārī 705).

revelation.detail: It is Makkan by agreement; both Ibn al-Jawzī and al-Qurṭubī say so. The traditional order places it twenty-sixth.

evidence.quote: سُورَةُ الشَّمْسِ وَهِيَ مَكِيهٌ كُلُّها بِإجْماعِهِمْ
سُورَةُ "الشَّمْسِ" مَكِّيَّةٌ بِاتِّفَاقٍ، وَهِيَ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ آية

attested.quote: أخْرَجَ ابْنُ الضُّرَيْسِ والنَّحّاسُ، وابْنُ مَرْدُويَهَ والبَيْهَقِيُّ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبّاسٍ قالَ: نَزَلَتْ سُورَةُ ﴿والشَّمْسِ وضُحاها﴾ بِمَكَّةَ
attested.says: Ibn ʿAbbās: it came down in Makkah. Recorded by Ibn al-Ḍurays, al-Naḥḥās, Ibn Mardawayh and al-Bayhaqī.

setting: No occasion is reported for it. It belongs to the first years of the call, and it is built the way those early surahs often are: an oath, a truth, and an example.

The oath takes in the whole visible world in pairs — sun and moon, day and night, sky and earth — and comes to rest on something that cannot be seen at all: the soul, and the One who shaped it and inspired it with its wickedness and its piety. Every human being is given the knowledge of both.

The truth sworn to is the shortest statement of success and failure in the Qurʾan. He has succeeded who purifies it; he has failed who buries it. The second verb, dassāhā, is to press a thing down into the earth and hide it: the soul is not destroyed by sin so much as smothered.

The example is Thamūd. They had been given a sign they had asked for — the she-camel — and told to leave her to drink in her turn. The most wretched man among them rose to kill her; they followed, and their Lord levelled them for it. Quraysh, who travelled past the ruins of Thamūd on the road to Shām, are being told what the denial of a messenger has cost before.
aim: To display the signs and favours of Allah in the horizons and in souls, so that souls are purified and held back from disobedience.

outline.title: The oaths
outline.summary: By the sun and its brightness, the moon as it follows it, the day as it displays it, the night as it covers it; by the sky and the One who built it, the earth and the One who spread it; by the soul and the One who proportioned it, and inspired it with its wickedness and its righteousness.

outline.title: What they are sworn to
outline.summary: He has succeeded who purifies it, and he has failed who buries it.

outline.title: Thamūd
outline.summary: Thamūd denied, in their transgression, when the most wretched of them rose up. The messenger of Allah said to them: the she-camel of Allah, and her turn to drink. But they called him a liar and hamstrung her — so their Lord crushed them for their sin and levelled them. And He does not fear the outcome.

keyAyah.why: The answer to eleven oaths. The Prophet ﷺ turned it into a supplication.

virtues.text: The Prophet ﷺ used to say: “O Allah, grant my soul its piety and purify it; You are the best to purify it. You are its Guardian and its Master.”
virtues.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلاَهَا

virtues.text: The Prophet ﷺ spoke of the man who hamstrung the she-camel, and said: “There rose to it a man of power and standing among his people, like Abū Zamʿah.”
To Muʿādh, who had made the prayer long for his people: “Why did you not pray with ‘Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High’, ‘By the sun and its brightness’ and ‘By the night when it covers’?”

before: Al-Balad said man was shown the two ways. Al-Shams says where: in his own soul, inspired with its wrong and its right.
after: Al-Shams divides people into the one who purifies the soul and the one who buries it. Al-Layl describes each at work — the one who gives and is mindful, and the one who withholds and thinks he needs nothing.

notable.label: The soul, and what it was inspired with
